taxonomic_note: Current POWO accepts Dianthera americana. Justicia americana remains the familiar Texas/U.S. field name and should stay a prominent alias/search term.
look_here_first: Aquatic or riparian colony-former with long narrow opposite leaves and long-peduncled axillary flower spikes; white flowers carry purple spotting on the lower lip.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Hays and Travis are exact target-zone records. Williamson is documented but is outside the project target-county list and does not count toward the three-county rule.

approval_exception.reason: Correct stale PASS while preserving learner admission.

best_field_traits: erect shoots from shoreline or shallow water
white flowers with purple spotting on lower lip
morphology_keys.comparison_training: Distinct from Justicia pilosella by tall glabrous water-edge habit and much longer narrow leaves.

comparisons.key_distinctions: Water-willow is aquatic, rhizomatous, tall and glabrous; J. pilosella is a tiny hairy dry-site mound.
